meaning: (Qal) to cease, break, come to an end

elsewhere.note: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die…
Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction…
